subject: QuestBridge — SIG questionnaire: control assertions, evidence plan, and delivery cadence
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@questbridge.com>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.ai
Cc: security@questbridge.com
Date: Tue, 12 Jun 2028 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: QuestBridge SIG — starter packet and timeline

Hi Olga,

Thanks again for taking the time last week. Attached is our SIG starter spreadsheet — we've highlighted the sections required for our procurement committee by 6/20. High-level ask: control mapping for SOC 2 and ISO 27001 controls that map to your hosted and private offerings, plus a list of substantiation artifacts we can download or access (diagrams, config snapshots, procedures, and sample logs).

Can you confirm:
- Who on your side will be the primary contact for SIG questions?
- Whether you can share a network boundary diagram and an SSO integration proof by EOD 6/15?
- If any of the controls are met by cloud vendor attestations (we'd like to see which are vendor-provided vs Redwood-provided)

I've attached QuestBridge_SIG_Questions_v1.xlsx. If it's easier we can accept a partial delivery and iterate — procurement just needs enough to start the legal review.

Thanks,
Elena Ruiz
Head of Vendor Security
QuestBridge

--- attachment: QuestBridge_SIG_Questions_v1.xlsx (xlsx) ---

From: olga_petrov@redwood.ai
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@questbridge.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, mina_haddad@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 12 Jun 2028 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: QuestBridge SIG — starter packet and timeline

Elena,

Appreciate the packet — we're on it. Quick answers up front:
- Primary contact: me (Olga). I'll own coordination and be the single point to QuestBridge.
- Deliverables: we can provide a boundary diagram and SSO proof by EOD 6/15.
- Vendor-provided controls: we'll call out GCP-managed controls vs Redwood-managed controls in the mapping.

Plan:
1) Karthik and Mina will produce the control crosswalk (SOC 2 / ISO 27001 -> SIG rows) and indicate evidence type (doc, sys dump, restricted snapshot).
2) Ben will produce a short package with the runtime/network diagram (redwood_network_edge_diagram_v2.pdf) and a summary of our single-tenant/private deployment differences.
3) I'll assemble a partial response for legal review by 6/16 and share a Drive folder link.

Do you have a preference for how we mark items 'sensitive' (i.e., require an NDA or secure transfer)? We can mark items and place them in a restricted subfolder.

Olga
Senior Manager, Product Security
Redwood Inference

--- internal note: attaching hosted_runtime_control_mapping.csv and network diagram ---

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: olga_petrov@redwood.ai
Cc: mina_haddad@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 13 Jun 2028 08:57:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: QuestBridge SIG — control crosswalk draft

Folks,

I've started the crosswalk: see hosted_runtime_control_mapping.csv (attached). Highlights and open items:
- SOC 2 CC6/CC7 mapping to our runtime: most tokenization/logging controls are 'Redwood-managed' except infra patching and certain hyper-threading settings which we attribute to GCP.
- ISO 27001 A.9 (access mgmt): we can provide screenshots of Okta SAML config and the audit log export — but need Mina to confirm retention windows we can share (sample logs only).
- SIG question cluster 15-18 (encryption key lifecycle): need Ben to confirm the KMS flow for Dedicated vs Hosted.

Open: I flagged ~12 rows that require an artifact (config export, how-to doc, or signed attestation). I'll mark those as 'sensitive' in the spreadsheet.

Karthik
Director, Applied Security

--- attachment: hosted_runtime_control_mapping.csv ---

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, olga_petrov@redwood.ai
Cc: mina_haddad@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 14 Jun 2028 15:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: QuestBridge SIG — diagrams and KMS notes

Karthik / Olga —

Attached: redwood_network_edge_diagram_v2.pdf. Notes:
- For Hosted API, customer data paths terminate in segmented proc pools on GCP with KMS-managed keys (GCP CMEK for persistent storage, customer-tenant keys for Dedicated where requested).
- For Private deployments (VPC/on-prem), we include an HSM/KMS integration runbook; I'll prepare an excerpt showing key issuance and rotation steps.
- Regarding SIG cluster 15-18: rotation policy is 90 days by default for tenant-level data keys; master key rotation is annually. We can provide a sample rotation log (sanitized).

I'll queue the runbook excerpt and a sanitized log for delivery to Olga's Drive folder. ETA 6/16 EOD.

Ben
Sr. Systems Engineer, Serving Runtime
--- attachment: redwood_network_edge_diagram_v2.pdf ---

From: olga_petrov@redwood.ai
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@questbridge.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, mina_haddad@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 16 Jun 2028 16:23:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: QuestBridge SIG — control assertions, artifacts, and delivery cadence

Elena,

We pulled together a partial response and uploaded materials to the secure Drive folder: https://drive.redwood.company/qb/SIG/response-draft
What you'll find in the folder (initial drop):
- Control crosswalk (hosted_runtime_control_mapping.csv) — indicates Redwood-owned vs vendor-managed controls, artifact requirement, and sensitivity flag.
- Network boundary diagram (redwood_network_edge_diagram_v2.pdf).
- KMS & rotation summary excerpt and a sanitized rotation log (available on request under NDA).
- A short README that maps SIG question clusters to files and the recommended path for redactions.

Requested next steps for QuestBridge procurement:
1) Confirm which rows you want as "public" vs "restricted" so we can prepare redactions.
2) If you need signed attestations for any control, confirm list and we'll engage Legal.
3) Let us know if an NDA is required for the sanitized logs — we can provision a secure transfer via our portal.

We can run a 30-minute walkthrough of the crosswalk and artifacts next week if that's helpful. Proposed times: Mon 6/19 10–12 or Tue 6/20 14–16 PT.

Olga
Senior Manager, Product Security
Redwood Inference

--- attachments: hosted_runtime_control_mapping.csv, redwood_network_edge_diagram_v2.pdf, hosted_runtime_readme.txt ---
